zh: Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral (DHE)：双方各用一次性私钥的有限域密钥交换，提供前向保密。
Supported Groups extension：客户端用于宣告可协商群列表的 TLS 扩展（原名 elliptic_curves）。
named group：文档内为 FFDHE 预留代码点区间、按强度命名（如 ffdhe2048）的有限域群。
safe prime：本文件群的构造前提，高 64 位与低 64 位置 1 以便高效归约。
nothing-up-my-sleeve：以自然对数的底导出模数、以排除秘密挑弱素数的构造方式。
deprecated group：§8.4 规定应由未来修订显式标记为弃用的弱有限域群。
en: Diffie-Hellman Ephemeral (DHE): finite-field key exchange in which each side uses a one-time private key, giving forward secrecy.
Supported Groups extension: the TLS extension a client uses to advertise its list of negotiable groups (formerly elliptic_curves).
Named group: a finite-field group reserved under FFDHE codepoints and named by strength (e.g. ffdhe2048).
Safe prime: the construction premise for this file's groups, with the high and low 64 bits set to 1 for efficient reduction.
Nothing-up-my-sleeve: deriving the modulus from the base of the natural logarithm to rule out secretly weak prime selection.
Deprecated group: a weak finite-field group that §8.4 says a future revision should mark deprecated.
